Subject Implementation of CCPAP Module of Payment from 16" September, 2014.
Sir/Madam.
CCPAP Module in the above said offices may be rolled out from 16" September,
2014.
2, The above offices may generate digitally signed CCPAP advice file and upload

the same to SBI SFTP server on 15.09.2014. The file of 15.09.2014 should contain the details
of cheques issued from A/c No. 1 & 10 on 15.09.2014 and also for the period preceding three
months prior to 15.09.2014, Thereafter, the file may be uploaded on a daily basis in respect of
cheques issued in A/c No. 1 & 10.

3. After uploading the file SBI will fetch the file available in designated folder of
SFTP server and perform further activities. Any technical issue for roll out of CCPAP may be
taken with Shri D.K. Pandey, AGM, SBI & Nodal Officer for EPFO and Shri S, K. Panda,
DDS). CCPAP has been rolled out in Delhi(South), Bandra, Thane, Dehradun, Jaipur, Laxmi
Nagar, Kota#Udaipur.

4. The concerned officials may be in readiness for sending the details of cheques
issued during the preceding three months prior to 16"" September, 2014 and thereafter on a daily
basis. All RPFCs may ascertain beforehand that the digital signatures are functional. A trial
run may also be conducted by respective RPFCs before the scheduled date.

Yours faithfully,

eolOning
